parse_sse_events: parse SSE text into a list of JSON event objects, skipping malformed lines and [DONE] sentinels
reassemble_anthropic: reassemble Anthropic streaming SSE events into a single structured response with content blocks, tool use, and usage
reassemble_openai: reassemble OpenAI streaming SSE events into a single response with content, tool calls, reasoning, and usage
parse_json_response: parse a JSON string response from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, or provider-native format into a normalized dict
normalize_entry: normalize a trace entry by parsing raw_response SSE or JSON into a structured response dict
canonicalize_entry: canonicalize a trace entry by converting Google request/response formats to standard content blocks and messages
detect_format: detect whether a trace entry uses Anthropic or OpenAI format based on its URL field
load_jsonl: load a JSONL file and return a list of parsed JSON objects, returning an empty list for missing files
load_llm_calls: load a trace JSONL file and filter to return only entries with type llm_call
